units.source_text: 新生的婴儿眉清目秀，非常肖似东宫太子。

en.t: The newborn baby had delicate, clear features and looked very much like the Crown Prince.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看了，立刻想起太子，思念之极，不能再忍，想进宫去看看他。

en.t: When Prince Genji saw the child, he immediately thought of the Crown Prince; overcome with longing and unable to bear it any longer, he wanted to go to the palace to see him.

units.source_text: 便在帘外对葵姬抱怨道：“我久不进宫，心甚挂念，今日颇思去走一遭。

en.t: So from outside the curtain he complained to Lady Aoi, "I have not gone to the palace for a long time, and it weighs heavily on my heart; today I rather wish to make a visit.

units.source_text: 但有话想和你面谈，隔帘传语，岂不太疏远么？”

en.t: But there are things I want to discuss with you face to face. Is it not far too distant to pass messages through a curtain?"

units.source_text: 侍女们劝请葵夫人：“夫妇之间，不须拘谨小节。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting urged Lady Aoi, "Between husband and wife, there is no need to stand on such small formalities.

units.source_text: 夫人虽然病体衰弱，膏沐不施，但和公子见面，何必隔帘？”

en.t: Although you are weakened by illness and have not dressed your hair or adorned yourself, why should you keep a curtain between you when meeting the prince?"

units.source_text: 便在夫人卧处旁边设一座位，请源氏公子进来。

en.t: They set a seat beside the place where the lady was lying and invited Prince Genji to come in.

units.source_text: 两人就对面谈话。

en.t: The two of them then spoke face to face.

units.source_text: 葵姬时时对答，但因病后衰弱，颇感吃力。

en.t: Lady Aoi answered from time to time, but because she was weak after her illness, it seemed quite difficult for her.

units.source_text: 源氏公子回想前日濒于死亡时那种模样，觉得现在好似身在梦境。

en.t: Prince Genji recalled how she had looked the other day when she was close to death, and felt that the present moment was like being in a dream.

units.source_text: 便共谈病势沉重时种种情况。

en.t: They then talked together about the various things that had happened when her illness was grave.

units.source_text: 忽然想起那天这气息奄奄之人突然魂灵附体、侃侃而谈时那种怪相，心中恐怖起来，对她说：“唉，要谈的话实在多，不过你现在身体还弱，应该静养。”

en.t: Suddenly he remembered the strange sight of that day, when this person, barely breathing, had suddenly seemed possessed by a spirit and spoken at length; fear rose in his heart, and he said to her, "Ah, there is truly much to talk about, but your body is still weak now, and you should rest quietly."

units.source_text: 便劝她服汤药。

en.t: He then urged her to take her medicinal decoction.

units.source_text: 众侍女睹此光景，都很高兴，想道：“不知他几时学会看护病人的。”

en.t: Seeing this scene, all the ladies-in-waiting were delighted and thought, "When did he learn how to care for a sick person?"

units.source_text: 葵姬这个绝色美人，现在为病魔所困，玉容消减，精神若有若无，那躺着的样子实在非常可爱可怜！

en.t: Lady Aoi, that peerless beauty, was now afflicted by illness; her lovely face had grown thin, her spirit seemed barely present, and the way she lay there was truly both adorable and pitiful.

units.source_text: 那浓艳的头发一丝不乱，云霞一般堆在枕上，美丽之极！

en.t: Her rich, lustrous hair was not disordered by a single strand, piling upon the pillow like clouds and mist, supremely beautiful.

units.source_text: 源氏公子异常感动，凝眸注视，心中想道：“年来我为了何事而对她感到不满呢？”

en.t: Prince Genji was deeply moved and gazed fixedly at her, thinking, "For all these years, what was it that made me feel dissatisfied with her?"

units.source_text: 便对她说：“我进宫去，参见了父皇，立刻回来。

en.t: Then he said to her, "I will go to the palace, pay my respects to my imperial father, and return at once.

units.source_text: 我们能够这样地促膝谈心，我真高兴！

en.t: I am truly glad that we can sit so close together and speak from the heart like this.

units.source_text: 近来岳母常常陪伴着你，我倘来得太勤，深恐她怪我不体谅病人，因此我不便多亲近你，心中很痛苦。

en.t: Lately your mother has often been staying with you, and if I came too frequently, I feared she would blame me for not considering an invalid's needs; for that reason I could not be near you often, and it has pained me deeply.

units.source_text: 但愿你身体渐渐好起来，我们便可回到本来的房间里去同居。

en.t: I only hope your health gradually improves, so that we may return to our original rooms and live together again.

units.source_text: 多半是岳父母太钟爱你，像小孩一般疼你，因此你的病不容易快好。”

en.t: Most likely your parents cherish you too much and pamper you like a child, and that is why your illness is not easy to recover from quickly."

units.source_text: 说罢便起身告辞。

en.t: Having said this, he rose and took his leave.

units.source_text: 此时公子服装异常鲜丽，葵姬躺着目送他，比平常格外热情地注视。

en.t: At that moment the prince's clothing was unusually bright and elegant, and Lady Aoi, lying there, watched him go, gazing at him with far more warmth than usual.
